<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex035012026-11-1604-40-05" status="reviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Colophon (10a1-10a4)"/>
         <lg><l>bla ma'i man ngag so sor gsungs pa ||</l> 
         <l>phyogs gcig bde blag rtogs phyir bsdebs pa ||</l> 
         <l>rang  <lb n="10a2"/> gi dran pa bskul ba'i don du ||</l>
         <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3880">dge slong bdud rtsi grags</rs> kyis bsdebs pa'o ||</l> </lg>
         <lg><l>dge ba 'di yis gang du skyes par ||</l> 
         <l>rnyed dka'i mi lus phun tshogs cing  ||</l> 
         <l><lb n="10a3"/> dge ba'i tshul khrims skyon med srung pa ||</l> 
         <l>dam pa bsten zhing mnyes par shog shig ||</l> </lg>
         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4710">yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi zhal gyi gdams pa thor <lb n="10a4"/> bu</rs>r bzhugs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
